## What does this PR do?

<!-- e.g. "Adds Musify" or "Removes Octave, project appears abandoned" -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Adding a new entry
- [ ] Removing or flagging an existing entry
- [ ] Other (formatting, docs, fixing a broken link, etc.)

## If adding a new entry, checklist

- [ ] Entry is not a duplicate of an existing entry
- [ ] Repository has at least 30 stars
- [ ] Repository is at least 30 days old
- [ ] Repository has a commit within the last 6 months (exceptions for offline players are acknowledged)
- [ ] README of the repository is in English, or has an English README linked in the primary README
- [ ] Repository has a release, APK, or binary, or a demo screenshot or GIF in its README
- [ ] Entry is added in the correct section, in alphabetical order

## If removing or flagging an entry, explain why

<!-- e.g. abandoned, repo taken down, archived, no longer open-source, duplicate, etc. Include a link/evidence if possible. -->
